description: Create a named checkpoint of the session's current state, e.g. before a risky edit. Returns {commit_id, message, total_commits}; pass commit_id to restore_session to roll back. Every call adds a new checkpoint. Checkpoints live in the session only and are lost when it closes or expires; to keep one in the Library's version history, call save_to_library after it (the version takes this message as its name).

message.description: Short description of the checkpoint, e.g. "before exit cap change"; also names the next Library version

session_id.description: Session ID returned by create_session (list_sessions shows the open ones)

name: commit_session
title: Commit session
